_comment: Cline (VS Code extension/CLI) does not auto-discover a project-committed MCP config. This file exists for parity with .mcp.json, .cursor/mcp.json, and .vscode/mcp.json, and as a copy-paste source. To actually use it: CLI, copy this mcpServers object into ~/.cline/mcp.json; VS Code extension, open the Cline panel's 'Configure MCP Servers' button (writes to cline_mcp_settings.json in VS Code global storage) and paste the same entries there. See docs/MCP-CLIENTS.md for both paths.
